items.title: Enstar enters into adverse development cover reinsurance agreement with Markel
items.summary: Enstar Group's subsidiary Cavello Bay Reinsurance has agreed an adverse development cover with Markel Insurance covering $4.8bn of reserves.

items.title: Healey’s budget paves way for brutal spending review, warns IFS
items.summary: The Institute for Fiscal Studies has warned that Chancellor John Healey's budget leaves a £28bn shortfall, setting up potential real-terms cuts and tax rise speculation next year.

items.title: UK government avoids major tax or spending commitments in 'breathing space budget'
items.summary: The Institute for Fiscal Studies confirmed the latest budget contained no major fiscal flaws following an autumn statement focused entirely on small-scale personal finance interventions.

items.title: Surety wins £3.5M indemnity fight as High Court rejects authority challenge
items.summary: The High Court has ordered Shapoorji Pallonji Mideast to pay a £3.5 million indemnity after dismissing arguments that the corporate signatory lacked authority.

items.title: Bereaved families exempt from tax on delayed civil service pensions
items.summary: The government has removed a two-year deadline for tax-free lump sum death benefits following administrative backlogs.

items.title: The Pensions Regulator publishes artificial intelligence guidance for schemes
items.summary: The Pensions Regulator has released a new framework outlining seven principles for trustees and scheme managers on deploying artificial intelligence.
